dct_title_s: Thailand Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2024
dct_description_sm: # Thailand Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for Thailand Floods (Nov 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Provinces of Songkhla and Satun, Thailand, Floods, 4 Dec 2024, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Provinces of Yala, Pattani, and Narathiwat, Thailand, Floods, 29 Nov 2024, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024)
